items.author: nuggethumanperson.bsky.social
items.context: Any of y'all play Moonstone Island? Is it worth getting for the deck building elements if I wasn't a fan of games like stardew valley?
items.text: From what I know, the deck building is part of the creature battles, and the life sim side is still a big part of the game. Worth checking recent reviews on whether that mix suits you.
items.verify: Moonstone Island: проверить, что это питомцы + карточные бои + жизнь-симулятор (по моим знаниям так, свежие отзывы не смотрел).

items.author: tickingtpk.bsky.social
items.context: What's a game you can replay a dozen times and still have a good time with? I need to know what everybody's comfort games are. #GamingCommunity #VideoGames
items.text: Stardew Valley is mine. Each season gives a replay a slightly different shape, so it never feels like the same evening twice.

items.author: sometimes.bsky.social
items.context: What about a life sim for the gamers without a Microsoft operating system or device?
items.text: Stardew Valley has a native Linux version and runs well on Steam Deck, if that helps.
